description: On the green tablecloth in front are piles of colorful plastic beads, a dark cup, and a black cord with a few beads already on it. The left hand steadies the cord near the middle while the right hand reaches to the small pile of black beads on the right, pinches one bead, brings it leftward to the cord’s end, and guides it onto the cord as the left hand keeps the cord aligned, then the right hand briefly returns toward the bead pile to pick up another.
